description: This file defines a Java interface PreEnforcer for creating processing units for an Akka stream graph. It includes method declarations for applying pre-enforcement logic asynchronously, with error handling support. It also contains constants and utility methods related to pre-enforcement within the context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PreEnforcer
classes.description: A functional interface defining pre-enforcement logic that operates asynchronously and may handle errors, used within the Eclipse Ditto's enforcement stream.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the pre-enforcement logic asynchronously to a given signal, returning a future with possibly modified headers.

methods.name: withErrorHandlingAsync
methods.description: Performs pre-enforcement with error handling, executing a subsequent function upon success or handling exceptions by sending error responses.
